articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Bayern brace for tough contract talks with Olise
articles.description: Bayern Munich could be facing an uphill battle to sign winger Michael Olise to a new contract. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.headline: Kylian Mbappé goes cycling despite José Mourinho warning
articles.description: Kylian Mbappé has shared a video of himself riding a bicycle on social media, just days after his Real Madrid manager, José Mourinho, said players couldn't go cycling because of the injury risks involved.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal among clubs chasing winger Yildiz
articles.description: Arsenal, Real Madrid and Bayern Munich are all chasing Juventus winger Kenan Yildiz. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Haaland wants LaLiga move over Arsenal
articles.description: Manchester City striker Erling Haaland favors a move to Spain over Arsenal. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.headline: Cucurella: Too soon to judge Mourinho's Madrid amid poor start
articles.description: Marc Cucurella has acknowledged Real Madrid have not started the season as they would have liked under new coach José Mourinho, but he says the team must be judged at the end of the campaign, not now.

articles.headline: Torres forced out of Spain squad; Madrid's Espí gets first call-up
articles.description: Spain striker Ferran Torres has withdrawn from the squad because of left ankle pain, ruling him out of the world champion's remaining Nations League games against the Czechia and Croatia in this international break.

articles.headline: Dembélé dismisses 'little squabbles' pitting him against Mbappé
articles.description: Ousmane Dembélé dismissed "little squabbles" online pitting him and Kylian Mbappé against each other in their quest to win this year's Ballon d'Or.

articles.headline: UEFA receives Real Madrid dossier on Barcelona-Negreira case
articles.description: UEFA has received "a substantial amount of documents" from Real Madrid related to its ongoing inquiry into the Negreira case, European football's governing body said on Thursday.

articles.headline: Portugal, Man United, Real Madrid: Cristiano Ronaldo's long history of rows with coaches
articles.description: Cristiano Ronaldo walked out of the Portugal national team's camp after being benched. It is far from the first high-profile row of his two decades at the top.

articles.headline: Clásico match ball for Barcelona vs. Real Madrid LaLiga clashes unveiled
articles.description: Whenever LaLiga rivals Barcelona and Real Madrid clash, the world watches. So it's only fitting that El Clásico gets its own bespoke match ball.

articles.headline: Thomas Tuchel tips Jude Bellingham for future England captain role
articles.description: England coach Thomas Tuchel said Jude Bellingham could one day become the national team's permanent captain.

articles.headline: Kylian Mbappé, Ibrahima Konaté, Fede Valverde expected to be available for El Clásico - source
articles.description: Injured stars Kylian Mbappé, Ibrahima Konaté and Federico Valverde are all expected to be available when Real Madrid face LaLiga title rivals Barcelona in El Clásico on Oct. 25, a source has told ESPN.

articles.headline: Martin Ødegaard lambasts Bernardo Silva kick: 'This has no place on a football pitch'
articles.description: Norway captain Martin Ødegaard was left furious by a late kick on his ankle by Portugal's Bernardo Silva in stoppage time of a Nations League game on Sunday.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool among clubs interested in Alexander-Arnold
articles.description: A group of Premier League clubs are keeping an eye on Trent Alexander-Arnold. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.headline: Zidane: Mbappe's injury is not good news
articles.description: Zidane: Mbappe's injury is not good news

articles.headline: Mbappé to leave France camp after injury while scoring in Zidane's debut
articles.description: Zinedine Zidane's first game in charge of France ended on a sour note as Kylian Mbappé was injured moments after scoring in a 1-0 Nations League win in Türkiye.

articles.headline: Jude Bellingham named England player of the year
articles.description: Jude Bellingham has been crowned England men's player of the year for the second time in a row.

articles.headline: José Mourinho on 'non-negotiable' rules for Real Madrid to follow: 'Don't betray me'
articles.description: José Mourinho has spoken about his managerial philosophy, warning of the importance of trust between players and coach -- and "non-negotiable" rules for his squad to follow -- as he looks to build a new winning team at Real Madrid.

articles.headline: European Golden Shoe: Who's leading Raphinha, Mbappé, Haaland in race for top goal award?
articles.description: Raphinha may have started the season on fire, but there's a little-known striker who is ahead of the Barça star in the race for the European Golden Shoe.

articles.headline: Marc Cucurella 'sent a subtle message' to try to tempt Rodri into Real Madrid move
articles.description: Real Madrid's Marc Cucurella has said he "sent a subtle message" asking Rodri to join him at Real Madrid this summer, before the midfielder opted to sign for rivals Barcelona.
